entries.en: You've got quite the reputation.
Well, we've got some problems that could use your attention.
The aliens overran the hot labs last week. Only Han Olar got out, and he ain't all there any more.
The first we knew, the bastards were clawing into my command post. We had a lot more staff then.
Yeah? Sure as hell doesn't feel like it.
You got my support.
I'm no xenobiologist. They're fast, vicious, and there's a hell of a lot of them.
The board sent an asari to clean up the mess. She went to the hot labs yesterday. We haven't heard from her since.
I don't know. I don't see what one person could do.
A Matriarch has the skill to keep herself alive for a long time.
All I can do is hold out here and protect the civilians.
Stand down.
Sorry. We couldn't be sure what was on the tram.
Even hopped up on stims, my people know the rule. Two legs good, four legs bad.
Hell if I know. I'm not assuming any-goddamn-thing.
Encountered, fought, seen men ripped apart by. We're all working on stims.
Bugs. Zillions of 'em, coming up the tunnels from the hot labs. My team's been running on stims for days.
Look. You're human, and that's enough that I won't shoot. But I'd like to know who you are.
Huh. I won't look a heavily-armed horse in the mouth.
Didn't figure you space jockeys liked getting mud on your boots.
Benezia? Yeah. She came through here.
She hasn't come back here. You came through Central Station, so she ain't there.
You want my personal opinion? Labs like that exist to do stupid crap that gets people killed.
It's built into one of the glaciers further down the mountain. Real old, thick, stable one. Something goes wrong, they heat it up and sink it into the ice.
I can't talk about everything. What do you need to know?
Beats me. I'm not supposed to know. So long as people don't start dying, it's not my problem.
It's designed to survive a breach. The turrets and alarms are routed from a control room out by the quarantine labs.
Secure enough that you shouldn't poke in corners.
Only the best get assigned to high-security facilities like this.
Have you checked the layout yet? Easily defensible by a few people. That's not counting the automated defenses.
What impresses me most is the turrets, alarms, and cameras. They're all routed through a central location, out by the quarantine labs.
One guy can lock down the whole facility. The security hub's the last logical fallback, and we'd have cover from the turrets all the way.
Yeah. I have enough to worry about.
We weren't expecting the initial wave. They made it inside. We lost some good people.
Those of us left are shorthanded. We've kept order by long shifts and stims. I don't like it, but I don't see an alternative.
I need to know more about the situation in the hot labs.
You're certain the Matriarch is still in the hot labs?
Did the aliens come from inside the facility, or did they attack from outside?
Tell me about the structure of the hot labs.
Tell me about Rift Station.
What kind of research is done here?
Tell me about the defenses here.
I was just impressed with your operation. Being able to weather a week of assaults is no mean feat.
I just wanted to offer some deployment advice. You're lucky these things are dumb animals. Three coordinated guys could take this place.
Automated defenses can be overriden.
Maybe I was wrong.
I'll keep out of your hair.
How are your people holding up?
I've always had enough to fall back on.
Only people with no skill need luck.
All the heroes from Skyllia got shipped home in coolers.
Want me to autograph your gun?
I see a problem, I take care of it. That's the job I signed up for.
Then stow the pleasantries and give me a sitrep.
We can talk later. What's the situation?
You were taken by surprise and had civilians to protect. You did a good job, Captain.
I'm packing fire and steel. They want to fight with claws and teeth, it's their funeral.
We've never seen anything like them. What do you know?
Benezia. Is she still over there?
I'm not going to let any of your people die.
I've got business with her. Stay out of my way.
I'd only be upset if they had fired.
Can those things work a train's controls?
I take it you've encountered those things.
I'd do the same. What's going on here?
My name's Shepard. I'm a Spectre.
Commander Shepard, Systems Alliance Navy. My crew came up from Hanshan.
Call me Shepard. I was sent to find an asari Matriarch.
The hot labs
This facility
The bugs came from the lab?
What's the facility like?
What do they do here?
How secure are you?
Your staff
You survived somehow.
This place is vulnerable.
Computers can be hacked.
Sounds good so far.
I'm good.
I make my own luck.
I'm no damned hero.
Take advantage of it.
I believe in being thorough.
So don't jerk me around.
You did well.
We'll clean them out.
What are they?
I'm not here to help.
No autopsy, no foul.
Can they run a train?
Expecting hostile company?
I don't blame you.
I'm here for Benezia.
Ask Dr. Olar. He's the only one who made it out of the hot labs. He's the only volus left in here.
What can you tell me about the aliens?
Aliens
God. I wish we could help those guys. I really do. But we can't risk contamination now.
Dr. Iallis? But she seemed like the most stable one here.
She was a commando in Benezia's service. A squad of geth were with her.
She was a huntress, pledged to the Matriarch. A group of geth were with her.
She was a huntress working for the Matriarch. A group of geth were with her.
She was a commando in Benezia's service. A group of geth were with her.
Geth? I didn't know. God's honest truth, I thought she was just another egghead. Son of a bitch.
Yeah, I hear th--
Hell! Man the perimeter!
Yeah. But you also have extra guns.
All right. You want to gamble with your life, you're not under my command. I'll have the guard let you in, but he'll lock the door behind you.
He'll run a full scan before he'll let you out. If there are any anomalies, you stay in there.
I'll radio ahead to let the guard know. Good luck.
I've heard about the problems in the quarantine lab. I'd like to recover the toxin cure.
I was attacked by the asari who was in here. She killed your guard.
We're not part of your defense plans. We're consuming extra rations, extra medi-gel...
If we survive, your employers will want a report from me. I wonder how much insurance they have on those scientists?
Dr. Cohen says there's no risk of contamination.
Those are reasonable precautions.
Great. We'll be stuck unless he decides we're healthy.
If that's the only way you'll let us in, I agree.
I want to help Dr. Cohen.
I was attacked.
Let us risk it.
I'll have to report this.
It's not contagious.
That's fair.
I don't like being trapped.
If that's what it takes.
Yeah, thanks for your help back there.
The attack just now! Where were you?
Thanks for the vote of confidence.
If you don't want to help us here, why don't you go to the hot labs?
It looked like you could handle it.
If you need my help for a probing attack, this place is doomed.
You ever heard of keeping a reserve?
You didn't need me.
"You're welcome."
I was ready if you needed me.
I'm Captain Ventralis. Why don't you get inside our defense perimeter so we can talk?
Oh, if you need any first aid, Dr. Cohen's downstairs in the med bay.
I heard that.
Yeah. Sorry.
You couldn't handle it?
I doubt that's enough.
Sorry. I didn't mean to pry.
Nothing is ever secure enough. But I don't plan on testing it personally.
Just curious.
There's an emergency elevator out by the trams. This card will let you activate it. It can take you down to the hot labs.
Normally, the crew gets to the labs using a tram from Central Station. We've got an elevator that connects directly, but it's for emergency use only.
Uh, listen. I'm not sending my people people down there. It's too dangerous. You understand?
Thanks for the help. Every few hours, a group comes up the tram tunnel. It's actually better since we locked down the elevator.
Their only other option is over the mountain and down through the ducts. And they freeze like everyone else.
